inspiration: Each zone type has three density tiers as separate sprites (res1-3, comm1-3, ind1-3 in images/zones/). The tier ladder reads at a glance and makes growth visible.
Forest is generated from three density bands (light, medium, dense) with four species each (TerrainGen.json, Showcase block). A layered procedural planting rule with no hand-placed trees.
Shoreline edge sets (images/terrain_shorelines/, 17 PNG) give water boundaries their own tile family, separate from the land terrain.
The menu sound family pairs one short positive and one short negative sound with several variants and mono copies (sound effects/menu/). A small consistent UI sound palette.
Buttons have default, clicked and pressed textures set in UIData.json. A clear three-state button with data-driven textures.
A decoration tile describes an abandoned woodland ruin with unknown builders (TileData.json, id BD_1x1_AbandonedBuildings). A short premise we can rewrite in our own words.
